description: The OMITTED-argument facility (ISO 14.9.4.4 GR11-12, 14.2.2 OPTIONAL, 8.8.4.8 omitted-argument condition): the OMITTED phrase in a CALL's USING list, the OPTIONAL phrase on a procedure-division-header formal, and the IS [NOT] OMITTED condition - all COBOL-2002 introductions (the 85 CALL general format has none of the three). The CALL argument is gated in CallBinder.Format1Narrowing with BY VALUE and the literal arguments (kb/Work PB4503; under --permissive at 85 the vendor extension); OPTIONAL, the condition and INVOKE's OMITTED at the VersionConformancePass parse arms (kb/Work PB133 wave C).
display: the omitted-argument facility (OMITTED / OPTIONAL / IS OMITTED)
vcr: M2 interprogram surface (design doc Edition gating: OMITTED arguments + the omitted-argument condition, 2002+)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. W133Q.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(4) VALUE 3.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CALL "SUB1" AS NESTED USING W OMITTED.
    STOP RUN.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SUB1.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-A PIC 9(4).
01 L-B PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-A OPTIONAL L-B.
P.
    IF L-B IS OMITTED CONTINUE END-IF
    GOBACK.
END PROGRAM SUB1.
END PROGRAM W133Q.
